summary.headline: Saturn with the Sun and Venus
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of Saturn’s conjunctions and aspects with the Sun and Venus, including hexagonal, trigonal, tetragonal, diametrical, and house-based configurations, with omens for kings, sojourners, women, weather, cities, trade, and war.
